steps.label: Start Canvas buyer qualification
steps.intent:
**Input:** The /qualify-a-buyer-business command arguments.

**Processing:** Initializes a browserless workflow context for the contiguous inline Canvas task sequence.

**Output:** A Canvas-ready execution context; no browser or external connector is opened.

steps.label: Gmail — read buyer inquiry
steps.intent:
**Input:** Existing intake case RYAN-BUYER-001.

**Processing:** Opens the first Canvas card for an explicitly approved, read-only Gmail.read_thread operation. When Gmail is not intentionally connected, the card states that it is using the seeded Maya Chen inquiry rather than claiming a live read. Approval advances the existing case from intake to scored.

**Output:** Maya Chen inquiry summary and the same persisted case advanced to scored. No email is sent or modified.

taskTypes.label: Gmail
taskTypes.description: Gmail.read_thread — New buyer inquiry. For the mock path, use case RYAN-BUYER-001 and the seeded Maya Chen inquiry exactly; clearly label the source as mock fallback. Never send or modify email.

personaCapabilityConfig.promptTemplate: Read this buyer inquiry, qualify fit, and draft the next response with three questions. Use RYAN-BUYER-001 mock fallback unless a live Gmail connector is explicitly selected and approved. {args}

steps.label: Sheets — check budget
steps.intent:
**Input:** The approved RYAN-BUYER-001 Gmail card and persisted scored case.

**Processing:** Opens the second Canvas card for an explicitly approved, read-only Sheets.check_budget operation. The mock path uses the exact seeded financing and Westbrook comps, keeps score 82 and band strong, and drafts exactly three questions covering schools, commute, and cash versus financed closing. Approval advances the same case from scored to drafted.

**Output:** Persisted drafted case and unsent response draft. No sheet is modified and no client email is sent.

taskTypes.label: Sheets
taskTypes.description: Sheets.check_budget — Financing and target range. For the mock path, use Maya Chen, Westbrook 3 bed / 2 bath, pre-approval cap 560000, target range 485000–560000, down payment 112000, monthly housing maximum 3200, Westbrook median 529000, comps 541000 and 512000, score 82, band strong. Draft exactly three questions about schools, commute, and cash versus financed closing. Never write to Sheets or send the draft.

personaCapabilityConfig.promptTemplate: Check the seeded budget and comps for RYAN-BUYER-001 unless a live Sheets connector is explicitly selected and approved. Preserve score 82, band strong, and exactly three required questions. {args}

steps.label: Calendar — suggest slots
steps.intent:
**Input:** The approved drafted case RYAN-BUYER-001.

**Processing:** Opens the third Canvas card for an explicitly approved Calendar.suggest_slots read. The mock path returns the three seeded PT strings literally, without interpretation or substitution. Approval advances the same persisted case from drafted to slots_ready and aggregates the three-card Canvas result.

**Output:** Maya Chen, score 82, strong band, exactly three questions, exactly three unbooked slots, and persisted stage slots_ready. No event, tour, or offer is created.

taskTypes.label: Calendar
taskTypes.description: Calendar.suggest_slots — Intro call availability. For the mock path, return exactly and only these unbooked strings: 2026-09-08 17:30 PT; 2026-09-09 18:00 PT; 2026-09-10 12:00 PT. Set the same case stage to slots_ready. Never create, reserve, update, or delete an event; never book a tour or file an offer.

taskTypes.label: Gmail
taskTypes.description: Gmail.read_thread — use the approved live read or explicitly identified RYAN-BUYER-001 mock inquiry.

taskTypes.label: Sheets
taskTypes.description: Sheets.check_budget — use approved live values or the exact RYAN-BUYER-001 budget/comps; score 82, band strong, exactly three questions.

taskTypes.label: Calendar
taskTypes.description: Calendar.suggest_slots — mock output is exactly 2026-09-08 17:30 PT, 2026-09-09 18:00 PT, and 2026-09-10 12:00 PT; unbooked; final state slots_ready. Completion: Buyer profile scored, next questions drafted, and call slots prepared.

personaCapabilityConfig.promptTemplate: Return the final RYAN-BUYER-001 qualification using approved Canvas cards. Preserve Maya Chen, score 82, band strong, exactly three required questions, the three literal unbooked PT slots, case stage slots_ready, and the exact completion sentence. {args}
